card.title: Warmly Withholding
card.instruction: Remain open, caring, and reassuring while revealing less with every new question.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your wedding dress reached our depot this morning. Please sit; I'll look after you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One of ours. Let me save you a wasted journey.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you at least give me their number?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You have me, and I'm staying right here with you.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 gives arrival and time; A3 only one of ours and A5 gives no contact details, just A's availability.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 collection request gets A3 unnamed depot and discouragement; B4 phone request gets A5 personal reassurance instead.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 propose practical ways to retrieve the dress, forcing A to withhold usable access while sounding helpful.

heightening.evidence: B4 asks for the smallest actionable detail; A5 supplies none and intensifies promised presence.

specificity.evidence: A1 wedding dress at a depot gives service stakes; B2 collection and B4 number make the withheld access concrete.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 you have me earns its hollow helpfulness from withholding the person B actually needs to contact.
